An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
